query.text: SELECT ProcessId, ParentProcessId, CreationDate FROM Win32_Process WHERE ProcessId = 58428 OR ProcessId = 55812 OR ParentProcessId = 58428 OR ParentProcessId = 55812

sharpenedRule: a live row with ParentProcessId P is P's child iff its CreationDate lies within P's recorded creation-to-exit interval (a process cannot create children before existing or after exiting, and the PID could not be reissued while the retained handle was open); outside the interval it belongs to another holder of the number and is unrelated; only rows within the 1 ms tolerance of a boundary stay ambiguous; state this in the execution binding in place of 'may be reuse/ambiguity'
knownPidRows: exits already recorded by retained handles; a row is PID reuse unless its creation equals the recorded creation, which would contradict an exit record and stays unresolved
noRowMeaning: no live direct child of caller or CMD at that instant; departed transient children and their descendants not covered
combinedEvidence: caller's only child CMD (exit recorded); executor's only child the caller (exit recorded); executor exit 1 reported by native transport
attempt-counter-r1 absent: supervisor never reached the point of launching case children
